snippet.description:
Why did everyone get so bent out of shape over the 2015 blue/gold dress debate? Color expert and neuroscientist Bevil Conway has a theory on what it means when we aren’t all seeing the same thing. 

This week on Unexplainable: What’s actually happening in our brain when we see color? Watch on Netflix or listen wherever you get your podcasts. 

Subscribe to our channel and turn on notifications (🔔) so you don't miss any videos: http://goo.gl/0bsAjO
